summary: Critical gaps prevent shipping: (1) Test file missing—task requires TDD (write tests first), but no test file provided; workflow `bun test` would fail. (2) Workflow violates DRY: checkout/setup-bun/install-deps repeated in both jobs (~test:18-31, bump-version:39-50). (3) No actionlint validation results provided—task requires `actionlint` pass. (4) No act-result.txt artifact—task explicitly requires this file with test results. (5) No evidence tests run through act. TypeScript code is strong (explicit types, clear interfaces, error handling), but deliverable is incomplete and unvalidated.
